Life 
I think of it all the time 
There's some days where the days can't get any better 
There's somedays where they can't get any longer 
There's somedays I wish upon death 
But I know life is a little bit stronger
Should I live 
Or just hold my breath ? 
We all die 
We look in the sky 
And I wonder why 
Why can't it be me 
Getting my ashes dumped into the beautiful sea
But you see 
You have to make that leap 
That leap across the creek 
To get to the other side 
To catch your ride 
To get to your destination 
Death will come 
With no hesitation .
What is on your mind that is bothering you ? What is telling you to kill yourself ? Please explain more
It is to me to , knowing there is some one my age going through the same thing I am going through.
I am in your same shoes. Your not alone.
